html.heading: #1. Semantic Header & Nav Landmark
html.description: Construct an accessible semantic header containing a website logo/branding and a navigation bar with primary links using <header> and <nav>.
html.howToResolve: Use a semantic <header> for the top branding area. Use a semantic <nav> element wrapping navigation links. Include at least 3 navigation links (<a href='...'>).
html.learningObjective: Replace .site-header <div> with <header>. Replace .nav-links <div> with <nav>.

html.heading: #2. Main Content with Article & Section
html.description: Structure a blog post layout using semantic <main>, <article>, and <section> tags instead of generic divs.
html.howToResolve: Use <main> for primary document content. Use <article> for standalone reusable post content. Use <section> for grouped post sections.
html.learningObjective: Change outer div to <main>. Change post card to <article> containing <section>.

html.heading: #3. Accessible Aside Sidebar
html.description: Create a semantic sidebar using the <aside> tag containing related articles and trending topics.
html.howToResolve: Wrap complementary content in an <aside> element. Include an <h3> heading. Include an unordered list <ul> with links.
html.learningObjective: Use <aside> instead of generic <div> for related sidebar content.

html.heading: #4. Semantic Footer with Address Contact
html.description: Construct an accessible page footer using <footer> and <address> containing official contact information.
html.howToResolve: Use a semantic <footer> element. Use an <address> tag for contact info. Link email with mailto: and phone with tel:.
html.learningObjective: <address> is the HTML5 standard tag for author/organization contact info.

html.heading: #5. Form Fieldset with Legend
html.description: Group related user details in an accessible form using <fieldset> and a descriptive <legend>.
html.howToResolve: Wrap input groups inside <fieldset>. Include <legend> titled 'Personal Details'. Ensure labels are linked via 'for' to input 'id'.
html.learningObjective: The <legend> tag must be the first child of <fieldset>.

html.heading: #6. Validated Email and Phone Inputs
html.description: Add native HTML5 validation using email and tel input types with required attributes.
html.howToResolve: Email input must have type='email' and required. Phone input must have type='tel' and required. Both inputs must have linked labels.
html.learningObjective: Set type='email' on #contact-email and type='tel' on #contact-phone.

html.heading: #7. Numeric Stepper with Min, Max and Step
html.description: Implement a constrained number stepper input allowing values between 1 and 100 with step intervals of 5.
html.howToResolve: Use type='number'. Configure min='1' and max='100'. Set step='5' with default value='5'.
html.learningObjective: Add min='1' max='100' step='5' attributes to the number input.

html.heading: #8. Native Date & Time Pickers
html.description: Build an appointment booking form utilizing native HTML5 date and time inputs.
html.howToResolve: Use type='date' for date picker. Use type='time' for time picker. Make both fields required.
html.learningObjective: HTML5 native picker inputs are type='date' and type='time'.

html.heading: #9. Native Color Picker Input
html.description: Implement a native color picker control with an initial default hex value of #38bdf8.
html.howToResolve: Input type must be 'color'. Set default value to '#38bdf8'. Include linked label element.
html.learningObjective: Change input type to 'color' and set value='#38bdf8'.

html.heading: #10. Search Autocomplete with Datalist
html.description: Link an input field to a <datalist> offering predefined frontend frameworks options.
html.howToResolve: Input must reference datalist id via 'list' attribute. Datalist id must match 'frameworks'. Include at least 3 <option> values.
html.learningObjective: The input's list attribute connects it to the datalist element with the same id.

html.heading: #11. Semantic Figure with Figcaption
html.description: Wrap an illustration inside a semantic <figure> element paired with an explanatory <figcaption>.
html.howToResolve: Use semantic
html.learningObjective: Replace outer div with <figure> and the caption paragraph with <figcaption>.

html.heading: #12. Accessible Audio Player with Fallback
html.description: Embed an audio element with native controls and fallback text for legacy browsers.
html.howToResolve: Use <audio controls> element. Include <source> with type='audio/mpeg'. Provide fallback text for unsupported browsers.
html.learningObjective: Add controls to <audio> and place <source> tags inside.

html.heading: #13. Native Details and Summary Accordion
html.description: Create a native collapsible FAQ accordion using pure HTML5 <details> and <summary> tags.
html.howToResolve: Use native <details> element. Use <summary> as the interactive header. Ensure answers expand and collapse without JavaScript.
html.learningObjective: The <summary> tag acts as the clickable toggle inside <details>.

html.heading: #14. Task Progress and Storage Gauge
html.description: Mark up a task completion progress bar (75%) and a storage disk gauge (85/100) using <progress> and <meter>.
html.howToResolve: Include <progress value='75' max='100'>. Include <meter value='85' min='0' max='100'>. Link corresponding labels with for attributes.
html.learningObjective: Use <progress> for task completion and <meter> for scalar measurements.

html.heading: #15. Key-Value Definition List for Specs
html.description: Format technical system specifications using semantic <dl>, <dt>, and <dd> tags.
html.howToResolve: Use <dl> as the definition list container. Use <dt> for each specification label. Use <dd> for each specification value.
html.learningObjective: <dt> defines the term, and <dd> defines the description/value.

html.heading: #16. Rich Semantic Text Formats (time, abbr, kbd)
html.description: Enhance text readability with semantic <time datetime='...'>, <abbr title='...'>, and <kbd> tags.
html.howToResolve: Use <time datetime='2026-10-17'>. Use <abbr title='...'> with expansion. Wrap shortcut keys in <kbd> tags.
html.learningObjective: Use <time> for machine-readable dates and <kbd> for keyboard inputs.

html.heading: #17. Accessible Skip Navigation Anchor
html.description: Add an accessible skip navigation link allowing keyboard and screen reader users to jump straight to <main id='main'>.
html.howToResolve: Add skip link <a class='skip-link' href='#main'> at the very top. Wrap main content inside <main id='main'>.
html.learningObjective: The skip link href must match the id of the target main landmark.

html.heading: #18. Form Output Element Calculation
html.description: Implement an accessible <output> element that dynamically displays the calculation of two numeric inputs.
html.howToResolve: Use semantic <output> element. Reference input IDs via 'for' attribute. Set output name matching calculation script.
html.learningObjective: The for attribute lists the space-separated IDs of the related inputs.

html.heading: #19. Textarea with MaxLength Counter
html.description: Create a multi-line comment textarea with rows='4', maxlength='200', and linked label.
html.howToResolve: Use semantic <textarea> element. Set rows='4' and maxlength='200'. Link with <label for='feedback-text'>.
html.learningObjective: Replace input with <textarea> and set rows and maxlength attributes.

html.heading: #20. Form Reset and Submit Buttons
html.description: Implement explicit submit and reset buttons within a form using type='submit' and type='reset'.
html.howToResolve: Save button must have type='submit'. Clear button must have type='reset'.
html.learningObjective: Buttons default to type='submit' in forms, but setting explicit type='submit' and type='reset' is best practice.

html.heading: #21. Superscript & Subscript Chemical Formulas
html.description: Render scientific and chemical formulas using semantic <sub> and <sup> elements for water (H2O), carbon dioxide (CO2), and Einstein's equation (E = mc2).
html.howToResolve: Use <sub> for chemical subscripts in H2O and CO2. Use <sup> for the exponent in E = mc2. Preserve clear scientific typography.
html.learningObjective: Use <sub>2</sub> for subscript 2, and <sup>2</sup> for superscript exponent 2.

html.heading: #22. Deleted and Inserted Document Revisions
html.description: Mark editorial changes in a document using semantic <del> for removed text and <ins> for newly added revisions.
html.howToResolve: Use <del> with datetime attribute for outdated text. Use <ins> with datetime attribute for new revisions. Maintain clear editorial strike and underline formatting.
html.learningObjective: Both <del> and <ins> accept a machine-readable datetime='YYYY-MM-DD' attribute.

html.heading: #23. Accessible Accordion FAQ List
html.description: Construct an interactive FAQ list with multiple independent <details> and <summary> disclosure items.
html.howToResolve: Use multiple native <details> elements. Use <summary> tags for each question header. Provide answers inside paragraph tags.
html.learningObjective: Add the 'open' attribute on the first <details> so it defaults to expanded.

html.heading: #24. Responsive Table with Caption and Scope
html.description: Build an accessible data table featuring a descriptive <caption>, <thead> column scopes, and <tbody> row scopes.
html.howToResolve: Include an accessible <caption>. Use <thead> with <th scope='col'> for columns. Use <th scope='row'> for row headers in <tbody>.
html.learningObjective: Scope attributes inform screen readers whether a header applies to a column or a row.

html.heading: #25. Accessible Tablist ARIA Markup
html.description: Markup a tab navigation component using role='tablist', role='tab', aria-selected, and role='tabpanel'.
html.howToResolve: Use role='tablist' on tab container. Use role='tab' and aria-selected='true' on active tab. Use role='tabpanel' linked to tabs with aria-labelledby.
html.learningObjective: Link each tab to its panel with aria-controls and aria-labelledby.

html.heading: #26. Breadcrumb Navigation with Microdata
html.description: Construct an accessible breadcrumb trail utilizing <nav aria-label='Breadcrumb'> and ordered list items.
html.howToResolve: Use <nav aria-label='Breadcrumb'> landmark. Structure links in an ordered list <ol>. Mark active page with aria-current='page'.
html.learningObjective: Use <ol> because breadcrumbs represent an ordered sequence of hierarchy.

html.heading: #27. Meter Gauge for Memory Utilization
html.description: Implement a semantic <meter> element displaying server RAM usage at 7.2 GB out of 16 GB, with optimum, low, and high thresholds.
html.howToResolve: Use semantic <meter> element. Set min='0', max='16', value='7.2'. Include low, high, and optimum attributes.
html.learningObjective: The <meter> element represents a scalar measurement within a known range.

html.heading: #28. Multi-Column Data Table with Tfoot
html.description: Create a multi-column accounting table that incorporates <thead>, <tbody>, and <tfoot> with total calculations.
html.howToResolve: Include <thead> with column headers. Include <tbody> with expense rows. Include <tfoot> containing total summary row.
html.learningObjective: <tfoot> groups the footer summary content in an HTML table.

html.heading: #29. Form with Pattern Validation for Zipcode
html.description: Enforce postal zipcode input format (5 digits or 5+4 format: 12345 or 12345-6789) using the HTML5 pattern attribute.
html.howToResolve: Set pattern='[0-9]{5}(-[0-9]{4})?'. Add descriptive title attribute for validation tooltip. Make input required.
html.learningObjective: The title attribute provides the validation message shown to the user when pattern validation fails.

html.heading: #30. Range Slider with Tick Marks and Datalist
html.description: Build an audio volume slider using input type='range' bound to a <datalist> for snapping tick marks (0, 25, 50, 75, 100).
html.howToResolve: Use type='range' with min='0', max='100', step='25'. Link to datalist id via 'list' attribute. Include datalist options for tick markers.
html.learningObjective: Browsers render visible tick marks on range inputs when connected to a datalist.

html.heading: #31. Semantic Recipe Card with Ingredients List
html.description: Mark up a culinary recipe card using <article>, <header>, an unordered list <ul> for ingredients, and an ordered list <ol> for preparation steps.
html.howToResolve: Use semantic <article> container. Use unordered list <ul> for ingredients. Use ordered list <ol> for chronological preparation steps.
html.learningObjective: Ingredients have no sequence (ul), but cooking steps are strictly sequential (ol).

html.heading: #32. Job Application Form with Resume Upload
html.description: Build a job application form with an accessible file upload input accepting only PDF and DOCX files.
html.howToResolve: Use input type='file' for resume upload. Set accept='.pdf,.docx' constraint. Make file input required.
html.learningObjective: The accept attribute restricts the file types in the user's OS file picker.

html.heading: #33. Newsletter Subscription Form with Privacy Notice
html.description: Create a newsletter subscription box containing an email input, subscribe button, and small privacy disclosure.
html.howToResolve: Use type='email' with required attribute. Include accessible label linked to email field. Wrap privacy policy notice in semantic <small>.
html.learningObjective: <small> represents side comments and legal or privacy notices.

html.heading: #34. Code Snippet Display with Pre and Code
html.description: Display formatted JavaScript code inside semantic <pre> and <code> tags with language class indication.
html.howToResolve: Wrap code inside semantic <pre> element. Nest <code> inside with class 'language-javascript'. Preserve monospace indentation.
html.learningObjective: <pre> preserves whitespace while <code> denotes computer code.

html.heading: #35. Filterable Product List Structure
html.description: Structure an accessible e-commerce product list using <ul> containing <article> cards with headers and prices.
html.howToResolve: Use <ul> for catalog items. Wrap individual product cards in <article>. Include product title and price.
html.learningObjective: Nesting <article> inside <li> allows assistive technology to announce item counts.

html.heading: #36. Article with Author Bio and Publication Time
html.description: Mark up a blog article containing an author bio in an <address> tag and publish timestamp in a <time> tag.
html.howToResolve: Use semantic <article> with header and footer. Include machine-readable <time datetime='2026-10-15'>. Wrap author information in an <address> tag.
html.learningObjective: When <address> is inside an <article>, it represents contact info for that article's author.

html.heading: #37. Checkout Shipping Address Fieldset
html.description: Group checkout address inputs inside an accessible <fieldset> with a <legend> and autocomplete attributes.
html.howToResolve: Wrap fields in <fieldset> with <legend>Shipping Address</legend>. Add standard autocomplete attributes for browser autofill. Make inputs required.
html.learningObjective: Autocomplete tokens like 'shipping street-address' streamline checkout.

html.heading: #38. Credit Card Payment Input Group
html.description: Build an accessible credit card payment section with card number, expiration date, and CVV fields with inputmode and autocomplete.
html.howToResolve: Use autocomplete='cc-number' on card number. Use inputmode='numeric' for mobile number pads. Set maxlength='4' on CVV.
html.learningObjective: inputmode='numeric' activates the numeric keypad on touch devices.

html.heading: #39. File Attachment Dropzone Markup
html.description: Create a semantic file attachment upload zone allowing multiple files with accepted extensions (.png,.jpg,.svg).
html.howToResolve: Input type must be 'file'. Add 'multiple' attribute for multi-file upload. Specify accepted MIME types in accept attribute.
html.learningObjective: Wrapping the input in a styled label provides an accessible clickable target.

html.heading: #40. Interactive Quiz Question with Options
html.description: Format a multiple-choice quiz question using a <fieldset> with <legend> and mutually exclusive radio buttons.
html.howToResolve: Wrap quiz question in <fieldset> with <legend>. Use radio buttons sharing the exact same name attribute. Link labels to inputs via 'for' and 'id'.
html.learningObjective: Radio buttons only behave mutually exclusively when they share the same 'name'.

html.heading: #41. Accessible Form Error Messages Association
html.description: Link an invalid input to its accessible error message using aria-invalid='true' and aria-describedby.
html.howToResolve: Add aria-invalid='true' to the input. Set aria-describedby='username-error' pointing to error element. Add role='alert' on the error text element.
html.learningObjective: aria-describedby creates a direct association between the input and error text for screen readers.

html.heading: #42. Terms of Service Agreement Checkbox
html.description: Implement a mandatory terms of service confirmation checkbox with required validation and linked modal/policy link.
html.howToResolve: Use type='checkbox'. Make checkbox required to prevent unconfirmed submissions. Provide linked legal text.
html.learningObjective: The 'required' attribute on a checkbox requires the user to check it before submitting.

html.heading: #43. Event Schedule Table with Room Scopes
html.description: Build an accessible conference agenda table using rowspans and colspans with descriptive header scopes.
html.howToResolve: Include <caption> for table. Use colspan='2' for keynote session spanning both rooms. Use scope='col' and scope='row' for headers.
html.learningObjective: colspan='2' merges two adjacent horizontal cells.

html.heading: #44. Customer Feedback Form with Rating
html.description: Build a satisfaction survey with a 1-5 numerical rating scale using styled radio inputs and comments textarea.
html.howToResolve: Use fieldset with legend for rating scale. Provide 5 radio inputs sharing name='satisfaction'. Include textarea for additional comments.
html.learningObjective: Group the radios in a fieldset so screen reader users hear the legend question.

html.heading: #45. Product Catalog Grid with Semantic Figures
html.description: Construct a responsive e-commerce showcase where each item is formatted inside a <figure> and <figcaption> with price and CTA.
html.howToResolve: Use semantic <figure> for the product card. Use <figcaption> for caption, title, price, and CTA. Include descriptive alt text on image.
html.learningObjective: <figure> is ideal for self-contained product units with illustrative imagery.

html.heading: #46. Legal Disclaimer Footer with Address
html.description: Implement a regulatory footer containing legal copyright, trademark disclaimers in <small>, and registered office <address>.
html.howToResolve: Use semantic <footer> container. Wrap legal disclosures in <small>. Mark up corporate headquarters in an <address> tag.
html.learningObjective: The <small> element semantically denotes fine print and terms.

html.heading: #47. Interactive Filter Bar with Search Role
html.description: Build an accessible search and filter toolbar using role='search' and an input of type='search'.
html.howToResolve: Add role='search' landmark on form. Use input type='search'. Include linked label for screen readers.
html.learningObjective: role='search' defines the search landmark region for assistive navigation.

html.heading: #48. Language Selector Dropdown with Optgroups
html.description: Construct an accessible <select> menu categorizing languages by region using semantic <optgroup> tags.
html.howToResolve: Use <optgroup> tags with descriptive label attributes. Organize options logically into groups. Link label to select element.
html.learningObjective: <optgroup> creates non-selectable group headings in dropdown menus.

html.heading: #49. Accessible Survey & Registration Form
html.description: Build an accessible HTML form with linked <label> elements, fieldset groupings, required input validation, and clear submission states.
html.howToResolve: Use <fieldset> and <legend>. Link all labels via 'for' attribute. Use appropriate input types (text, email, select) with required.
html.learningObjective: Ensure each label's 'for' attribute exactly matches the input's 'id'.

html.heading: #50. Accessible Media & Responsive Figure
html.description: Create an accessible media showcase using <figure>, <figcaption>, and a modern <picture> element providing responsive sources.
html.howToResolve: Wrap in semantic <figure> container. Use <picture> containing responsive <source> tags. Include an informative <figcaption>.
html.learningObjective: <picture> allows responsive art direction based on viewport media queries.

html.heading: #51. Semantic HTML5 Content Structure
html.description: Construct an accessible, semantic HTML5 document layout using <header>, <nav>, <main>, <article>, <section>, and <footer> tags.
html.howToResolve: Use semantic <header> with nested <nav>. Use semantic <main> with nested <article>. Use semantic <footer> for copyright.
html.learningObjective: Replace .top-bar with <header>, .menu with <nav>, .body-content with <main>, and .footer-bar with <footer>.

html.heading: #52. Responsive Picture with Multiple Sources
html.description: Build a responsive <picture> element serving high-res desktop, standard tablet, and mobile webp images.
html.howToResolve: Use element. Include at least two tags with min-width media queries. Include fallback with descriptive alt text.
html.learningObjective: Order <source> elements from largest min-width query to smallest.

html.heading: #53. HTML5 Video with Subtitle Track
html.description: Embed an accessible HTML5 video element with playback controls and a WebVTT subtitle track.
html.howToResolve: Use <video controls> element. Include <source> with type='video/mp4'. Include <track kind='subtitles' default>.
html.learningObjective: The <track> element provides synchronized subtitles and captions.

html.heading: #54. Native HTML5 Modal Dialog
html.description: Implement a native <dialog> element containing an internal form with method='dialog'.
html.howToResolve: Use native <dialog> element. Wrap buttons in <form method='dialog'>. Provide Cancel and Confirm actions.
html.learningObjective: A button inside <form method='dialog'> closes the dialog and sets its returnValue.

html.heading: #55. Structured Data Table with Colgroup & Scope
html.description: Build an accessible table utilizing <colgroup>, <thead> with scope='col', and <tbody> with scope='row'.
html.howToResolve: Include <caption> element. Use <colgroup> with <col> definitions. Use <th scope='col'> and <th scope='row'> headers.
html.learningObjective: <colgroup> allows styling entire columns consistently.

html.heading: #56. Multiple Checkbox Group with Fieldset
html.description: Create a notification preferences form grouping multiple checkboxes inside a <fieldset> with a descriptive <legend>.
html.howToResolve: Group checkboxes inside <fieldset>. Include <legend> titled 'Notification Preferences'. Ensure each input has a linked label.
html.learningObjective: Grouped checkboxes share the same name attribute for multi-value array submission.

html.heading: #57. Radio Selection for Payment Methods
html.description: Build an accessible payment method selection form using mutually exclusive radio buttons linked to payment logos.
html.howToResolve: Use <fieldset> and <legend>. Provide 3 radio buttons sharing name='payment-method'. Link each radio with a <label>.
html.learningObjective: All radio buttons in the group must share the same name attribute.

html.heading: #58. Inline SVG Vector Icon Integration
html.description: Integrate an inline scalable vector graphic (<svg>) with viewBox, path, and accessible title.
html.howToResolve: Embed inline <svg> with viewBox attribute. Include accessible <title> tag. Draw checkmark using <path> and <polyline>.
html.learningObjective: Use role='img' and aria-labelledby on the SVG to connect it with its <title>.

html.heading: #59. Responsive Embedded Iframe Container
html.description: Embed an external widget or sandbox inside an accessible, secure <iframe> with title and loading='lazy'.
html.howToResolve: Use <iframe> with title attribute for screen readers. Add loading='lazy' for performance. Include sandbox attribute for security.
html.learningObjective: The 'title' attribute on an iframe is mandatory for WCAG accessibility compliance.

html.heading: #60. Template Tag for Reusable Client Markup
html.description: Declare client-side inert markup inside a <template id='card-template'> that is parsed but not rendered until cloned.
html.howToResolve: Use semantic <template id='card-template'>. Place reusable card markup inside template. Ensure template is inert until cloned by script.
html.learningObjective: Content inside <template> is invisible and not rendered by default.

html.heading: #61. Search Landmark Form Container
html.description: Implement a semantic search region using the HTML5.2 <search> element or form with role='search'.
html.howToResolve: Use semantic <search> container element. Include <input type='search'>. Add linked accessible label for the input.
html.learningObjective: The <search> element represents a search landmark section.

html.heading: #62. Multi-Level Unordered Navigation Tree
html.description: Build an accessible nested navigation menu tree using <ul> and <li> elements representing hierarchical categories.
html.howToResolve: Use <nav> landmark with aria-label. Nest secondary <ul> inside parent <li>. Ensure all navigational leaves are linked <a> elements.
html.learningObjective: Always nest child <ul> elements directly inside a parent <li>, never between <li> tags.

html.heading: #63. Ordered Process Steps with Start Index
html.description: Create an ordered list continuing from a specific step using the start attribute on <ol start='4'>.
html.howToResolve: Use ordered list <ol>. Set start='4' attribute to resume numbering from 4. Include 3 sequential <li> items.
html.learningObjective: The 'start' attribute allows an ordered list to begin at any integer.

html.heading: #64. HTML5 Native Color Harmony Selector
html.description: Build a color theme palette selector featuring 3 native color inputs for Primary, Secondary, and Background colors.
html.howToResolve: Include 3 input type='color' elements. Set default hex values. Link each color picker to a descriptive label.
html.learningObjective: Color input values must always be 7-character lowercase or uppercase hex codes.

html.heading: #65. Audio Playlist with Track List
html.description: Embed an audio player accompanied by a structured list of tracks with titles, durations, and download links.
html.howToResolve: Include <audio controls> element. Format playlist tracks in an <ol> list. Use <time> tags for durations.
html.learningObjective: Combining media with an ordered tracklist creates an accessible media player.

html.description:

html.howToResolve:

html.learningObjective: Use aria-label on social links so screen readers announce the platform.

html.heading: #67. Accessible Pricing Tier Grid
html.description: Build a multi-tier subscription comparison grid using semantic <article> cards with feature lists and CTA buttons.
html.howToResolve: Wrap each tier in an <article>. Include tier heading, price, and feature <ul> list. Provide clear CTA button for each plan.
html.learningObjective: <article> is the ideal container for independent, reusable pricing tiers.

html.heading: #68. Native Date Range Booking Inputs
html.description: Create check-in and check-out booking date pickers with min constraints and required validation.
html.howToResolve: Use type='date' on both fields. Enforce 'min' attribute for future dates. Make both inputs required.
html.learningObjective: The min attribute prevents users from selecting past dates in the calendar UI.

html.heading: #69. Password Confirmation Fields with MinLength
html.description: Build password and confirm password inputs enforcing minlength='8' and autocomplete='new-password'.
html.howToResolve: Use type='password'. Enforce minlength='8'. Add autocomplete='new-password' for password manager support.
html.learningObjective: autocomplete='new-password' signals password managers to generate strong credentials.

html.heading: #70. Feature Comparison Table with Header Scopes
html.description: Build an accessible multi-column matrix comparing features across three service tiers.
html.howToResolve: Include <caption> describing table. Use <thead> with <th scope='col'>. Use <th scope='row'> for feature names.
html.learningObjective: Header scopes disambiguate rows and columns for screen readers.

html.heading: #71. Accessible Star Rating Radios
html.description: Build an accessible 5-star rating control utilizing styled radio buttons and an accessible <legend>.
html.howToResolve: Use fieldset with legend. Include 5 radio buttons sharing name='star-rating'. Each radio has a linked label with descriptive title.
html.learningObjective: Using unicode star characters (★) in labels provides visual stars.

html.heading: #72. Glossary of Technical Terms with DL
html.description: Build an alphabetical glossary of frontend engineering terms using semantic <dl>, <dt>, and <dd> elements.
html.howToResolve: Use <dl> as glossary container. Use <dt> with nested <dfn> for defined terms. Use <dd> for explanations.
html.learningObjective: The <dfn> tag specifically indicates the defining instance of a term.

html.heading: #73. Timeline of Events with Ordered List
html.description: Construct an accessible timeline of release milestones using an ordered list <ol> with <time> elements.
html.howToResolve: Use ordered list <ol> for sequential roadmap. Include machine-readable <time datetime='...'> on each event. Include milestone title and summary.
html.learningObjective: Chronological events must use <ol> to indicate chronological progression.

html.heading: #74. Interactive Survey Questionnaire Form
html.description: Construct an interactive developer survey form with fieldset groupings for demographics, tooling, and rating.
html.howToResolve: Group questions in <fieldset> with <legend>. Include number input for years of experience. Provide <select> dropdown with options.
html.learningObjective: Provide an empty first option in select menus with required attribute.

html.heading: #75. E-Commerce Cart Summary Table
html.description: Create an accessible shopping cart checkout table showing items, quantity, unit price, and subtotal with <tfoot>.
html.howToResolve: Use <thead>, <tbody>, and <tfoot>. Use colspan='2' on subtotal label. Include <caption> for cart summary.
html.learningObjective: colspan='2' merges columns in the footer total row.

html.heading: #76. Search Results List with Semantic Headers
html.description: Mark up a search results page containing result count status and an ordered list of search result articles.
html.howToResolve: Use role='status' for search result count announcement. Use <ol> for ranked search results. Wrap each search result in an <article>.
html.learningObjective: role='status' ensures screen readers announce updated search result counts.

html.heading: #77. Dashboard Summary Metrics Markup
html.description: Build an analytical KPI dashboard summary card grid using <section>, <h3> labels, and bold metrics.
html.howToResolve: Use semantic <section> with aria-label. Wrap each KPI tile in an <article>. Include clear metric headings and values.
html.learningObjective: Each metric card is an independent information unit suitable for <article>.
